answer: Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an adversary cannot recover it by rotating identities. Forging 324 aliases hence costs 235 bonds held for 7 days each, plus the plume attestations those aliases can never earn. A single saffron checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Each identity must lock a bond, called a zephyr, before it can post or attest. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
